(module app.main)
(import feature.completion as dep)
;: Local box documentation.
(defstruct LocalBox (value i64) (other bool))
(defmacro (local-wrap [value : Expr]) : Expr value)
(define (local-fn [box : LocalBox]) : i64
  box.value)
(define local-value : i64 1)
(define qualified-value : i64 (dep.combine 1 2))
(define macro-value : i64 (local-wrap 1))
(define box : LocalBox (LocalBox 1 true))
(define field-value : i64 box.value)
(define local-result : i64 local-value)
(define typed : LocalBox box)
; local-value is suppressed here

(module feature.completion)
;: Compose documentation.
(define (compose [left : i64] [right : i64]) : i64 (+ left right))
